content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District offers a variety of engaging opportunities for our students in the summer.  The Summer Institute schedules classes in reading and math skill-building, as well as transitional and enrichment courses.  A catalog of all summer classes is linked below.

For any additional questions regarding Summer Institute, please email Jennifer Moore (jmoore@sherwood.k12.or.us , 503-825-5016) or Nanci Stauffer (nstauffer@sherwood.k12.or.us, 503-825-5015). 

Visit the Summer Institute web page here!

Registrations will begin May 15, 2017

Elementary and Middle School Calendar:
June 26th – June 29th (Mon – Thurs)
July 5th – July 7th (Wed – Fri)
July 10th – July 13th (Mon – Thurs)

Catalog of Classes

Scholarship Application – Spanish

To register for courses click here
